original_poem:
କଳିଙ୍ଗ ଗାଥା  
ଏଠାରେ ଅନୁକ୍ରମ  
ସଂସାରର ସତ୍ୟର ସାକ୍ଷାତ୍କାର,  
ଘରରେ ମୁକୁରା ଏବଂ  
କୃଷ୍ଣଙ୍କ ସଙ୍ଗରେ।  
ଗହର ଶବ୍ଦ ଓ ଶତକୋଟି ନର ତଥା  
ମାତୃକା ହୃଦୟର ରମ୍ୟା।
translated_poem:
The tale of Kalinga,  
Here unfolds a sequence,  
The realization of truth in the world,  
In the home with the mirror,  
And with Krishna.  
The sound of the depths and the countless men,  
The beauty of a mother’s heart.

metaphor_spans.abstract_meaning: the domestic mirror as site of self-recognition and worldly truth
the resonant sound of the depths as the voice of collective human experience
the divine maternal heart as the ultimate source of beauty and compassion
